test_title: PYST 59: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. When we connect this design with a wire, electricity flows.

B. These metal strips were put in a sulphuric acid solution.

C. He made two strips of different metals.

D. Alessandro Volta discovered electric battery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing the discovery of the electric battery by Alessandro Volta.
 
• **Sentence D is the first sentence** as it introduces the main subject:
 
 
• "Alessandro Volta discovered electric battery."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it describes the initial steps Volta took in his experiment:
 
 
• "He made two strips of different metals."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B is the third sentence** because it explains what was done with the metal strips:
 
 
• "These metal strips were put in a sulphuric acid solution."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A is the fourth** as it describes the outcome of the experiment:
 
 
• "When we connect this design with a wire, electricity flows."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **DCBA**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Alessandro Volta discovered electric battery. He made two strips of different metals. These metal strips were put in a sulphuric acid solution. When we connect this design with a wire, electricity flows."
